Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (July 23, 2020) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Proposal for Ariba Doc No. 2278656726 Description: To provide Engineering Services for the Technical Oversight of Process Operations at Two (2) of the City's Organic Processing Facilities for a Period of Five (5) years for the City of Toronto’ Solid Waste Management Services Division. Recommended Supplier: GHD Limited Contract Award Value: $6,204,996 net of all applicable taxes and charges $7,011,645 including HST and all applicable charges $6,314,204 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on date of award for a period of five (5) years.
